answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the inlet log shows the live set and the island audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 257 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 210 aliases alive thus means 210 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the shale quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
